title: Love & Ponystep
desc_lfm_album: Love & Ponystep is the twenty-first studio album by American electronic musician Vylet Pony (Zelda Trixie Lulamoon), released in July 2025 by the independent record label Horse Friends Music / 32.7 The Creek. It was inspired heavily by electronic dance music, brostep, and electropop, including extensive sampling from video games and internet media from the 2010s. The album explores themes of Internet culture, criticism of copyright, and self-acceptance within an allegorical story mirroring the experience of Lulamoon to ponysonas. The album's title references ponystep, a bronyspeak term that originated in the early years of the brony fandom that described a .

title: CUTIEMARKS (And the Things That Bind Us)
desc_lfm_album: CUTIEMARKS (And the Things That Bind Us) is an album by Vylet Pony released on July 30, 2021. It was conceptualized based on a conversation it had with Kai, "who narrated — in short — their thoughts that had inspired the album." In an Sonemic interview on the website Rate Your Music, Vylet says that "CUTIEMARKS (And the Things That Bind Us) was really the thing that I think shifted my listener base into looking into the story aspects of my work more."
